description: Check an app is safe to launch, before deploying it or whenever asked. Finds the security holes and deploy-breakers AI-built apps ship with (database tables anyone can change, keys in the browser or the repository, AI routes anyone can run up, pages that 404 on the host, imports that fail on Linux) and says how to fix each one. Works on any app folder: no launchpad.json, account or credentials needed. Reads the files git would commit, on this machine; nothing is uploaded.

dir.description: Absolute path of the app's folder.

domain.description: The app's domain, e.g. example.com, to also check its email will reach inboxes (SPF, DKIM, DMARC). Optional.

name: launchpad_launch_check
